title: Grateful Dead Live at University Of Iowa Fieldhouse on 1982-08-10

ai_review.summary: Outstanding matrix recording with crystal‑clear sound and a fiery 'Roses' performance plus a monster China>Rider and Sugar Magnolia.
ai_review.review: The matrix blend of board and audience delivers an almost surround‑sound clarity that makes this 1982 show sound like you’re right on the stage, especially on the superb rendition of "Roses."  The band is described as “on fire” throughout a long first set and a second set highlighted by an extended China>Rider, high‑tempo Eyes of the World, and a rocking Sugar Magnolia encore.  While one reviewer called the overall show sloppy, the overwhelming consensus is that both the musical energy and the recording quality are top‑tier.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 5‑star praise for both performance and matrix sound, with only a single moderate critique; the weighted average leans strongly toward a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Matrix blending of board and audience provides exceptional clarity, depth and a surround‑sound feel; minor channel sync issues noted but not detrimental.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long, upbeat first set with a killer opener and smoky closer; second set features an expansive China>Rider sequence, high‑energy jams, and a double encore that maintains momentum to the finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as 'extremely on', hitting every note with incredible tone; his voice is noted as cool, clear and crisp on 'Roses'.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for dropping huge bass bombs, especially during Sugar Magnolia.
